correctness.rationale: After reducing (a,b) by gcd (a Haar-preserving circle dilation), the normalized positive and negative level arcs have width 2/m. Fourier expansion gives exact periodic Bernoulli formulas: odd-odd P=8/m² +2[ B((b−a)/m)−B((a+b)/m)]/(ab), and opposite-parity P=8/m²+[B(2(b−a)/m)−B(2(a+b)/m)]/(2ab). B(x)−B(x+δ)≥−δ(1−δ) follows from its affine-on-two-interval difference. The proof exhausts odd-odd b≤L_m and b>L_m and mixed parity low/high a cases, with exact isolated m=5 exceptional pair {1,9}; strict inequalities exclude other minimizers. This proves all unbounded positive frequencies and all m≥5, not just grid experiments. The waveform extension depends only on equal antipodal level arcs. Independent exact arithmetic tested 98,200 coprime tuples and reproduced sharp bounds/equalities as supplementary evidence.
